solutions.title: Recursive DFS
solutions.strategy: Recursively traverse left subtree, recursively traverse right subtree, then visit node.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node in the tree is visited once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Call stack frames correspond to the height h of the tree.

solutions.title: Iterative two stacks
solutions.strategy: Traverse root-right-left using a primary stack and push to an output stack to reverse into left-right-root order.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every node is pushed and popped through the stacks once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Secondary stack stores all n node values before assembling the final output.
